title: Vampire Vape Koncept Smooth Tobacco E-Liquid Short Fill 50ml
description: Prepare to indulge in pure vaping bliss with 50ml E-Liquid Koncept Smooth Tobacco by Vampire Vape. With each seriously smooth draw, you can savour the gentle yet robust taste of Virginia Tobacco. That has been expertly blended with the luxurious and creamy notes of decadent Vanilla. The result is a layered vape indulgence that's sure to please. With each inhale of this Vampire Vape Smooth Tobacco Koncept 50ml, you'll be captivated by warm layers of tobacco. While the exhale leaves you enveloped in the smooth, velvety embrace of vanilla. Each working together to deliver a deeply satisfying vape indulgence that will keep you coming back for more. Crafted with precision and care, this Vampire Vape Koncept XIX Shortfill is formulated to deliver long-lasting flavour that lingers on your palate. So whether you're a connoisseur or a vaping enthusiast, this 50ml Vampire Vape Koncept Shortfill guarantees an exceptional vape indulgence. That offers a truly memorable taste sensation with every puff. Each bottle of this Vampire Vape Koncept Smooth Tobacco Short fill E-Liquid contains 50ml of nicotine-free liquid. With 10ml of additional space to add your preferred nicotine shot . Allowing you to customise the nicotine strength according to your preferences. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to this Vampire Vape Koncept XIX 50ml Shortfill will give you 60ml of delicious 3 mg E-Liquid. To ensure optimal blending, don't forget to give the bottle a good shake after adding your desired amount of nicotine. If you love this 50ml bottle of Vampire Vape juice, why not explore their other equally delicious popular flavours. Their iconic E-Liquid collection offers a broad range to choose from to suit a variety of vaping needs. So whether you're looking for your next seriously smooth nicotine salt Vampire Vape Nic Salt for a perfectly smooth throat hit. Or inspired to make your own vape juice blends with their Vampire Vape Flavour Concentrates. You're sure to find a vape juice flavour and type that suits your vaping needs.
